tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background and the default card fill (service cards, work cards, footer).

tokens.name: bg2
tokens.usage: Alternate band background: marquee strip, stats and process sections, service-card hover.

tokens.name: bg3
tokens.usage: Image placeholders and media wells (work-card and Bancada image backgrounds).

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Branco Creme. Primary text, headlines and the primary button fill on bg, bg2, bg3 (16:1 on bg).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The accent IS the cream white — the brand has no hue. Hover underlines, scroll bar, stat bars.

tokens.name: white-dim
tokens.usage: Secondary text: body copy, sub-heads, the serif italic half of headlines, nav links. ~5.6:1 on bg.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: eyebrows, numbering, captions, service descriptions. About 3:1 on bg — below 4.5:1, so the source uses it only for small labels; prefer white-dim for anything someone must read.

tokens.name: white-border
tokens.usage: Every hairline: 1px section rules, card grids, outline buttons, tag borders. Decorative only (not a 3:1 control border).

tokens.name: white-subtle
tokens.usage: Translucent fills: feature tags, hero badge (with blur), outline-button hover.

tokens.name: status-live
tokens.usage: The single non-neutral colour: the pulsing 'available' dot in the hero badge. Never for text or large areas.

tokens.name: black-deep
tokens.usage: Preto Profundo (brand manual). Deepest ground for print and brand documents; start of the institutional gradient.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Preto Base (brand manual). Page ground in brand documents; the site uses the warmer bg (#111110).

tokens.name: graphite-dark
tokens.usage: Grafite Escuro (manual). Raised surfaces in documents, gradient step.

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: Grafite (manual). Panels and blocks on black grounds; institutional gradient.

tokens.name: graphite-mid
tokens.usage: Grafite Médio (manual). Decorative dots, section numbers in documents (decorative only on black).

tokens.name: graphite-light
tokens.usage: Grafite Claro (manual). Last gradient step; large decorative blocks.

tokens.name: silver-dark
tokens.usage: Prata Escuro (manual). Labels and captions in documents; 3.4:1 on black — use at 24px+ or for non-essential labels only.

tokens.name: silver
tokens.usage: Prata (manual). Auxiliary text in documents; 5.3:1 on black.

tokens.name: silver-light
tokens.usage: Prata Claro (manual). Auxiliary text in documents; 8:1 on black.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: Hero headline, set UPPERCASE in white. Fluid on the site: clamp(64px, 8vw, 120px); 38–68px under 900px.

styles.name: display-cta
styles.usage: Closing call-to-action headline, UPPERCASE, centred. clamp(48px, 7vw, 100px).

styles.name: stat-number
styles.usage: Big numbers in the stats band. clamp(56px, 6vw, 88px).

styles.name: heading-section
styles.usage: Section headlines (about, services, Bancada), UPPERCASE. clamp(36px, 4vw, 56px).

styles.name: badge-stat
styles.usage: The figure inside the floating hero badge.

styles.name: serif-hero
styles.usage: The italic second line of the hero, sentence case, in white-dim. Always paired under a display-hero line, same size.

styles.name: serif-section
styles.usage: Italic half of section headlines, in white-dim, on its own line under heading-section.

styles.name: heading-service
styles.usage: Service names in the services grid, UPPERCASE; also the nav wordmark text.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Criamos experiências digitais e visuais com identidade única.
styles.usage: Long-form paragraphs (about, Bancada) in white-dim. The hero sub uses 1.7 leading at max-width 440px.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Sites e landing pages com design sofisticado.
styles.usage: Card and step descriptions, footer links.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Section eyebrows above headlines, UPPERCASE, in muted. The hero tag widens to 0.35em.

styles.name: nav-link
styles.usage: Navigation links and text links, UPPERCASE; white-dim, white on hover. Outline buttons use weight 500.

styles.name: stat-label
styles.usage: Labels under stat numbers and section counts, UPPERCASE, muted.

styles.name: index-number
styles.usage: Two-digit numbering on service cards and process steps; marquee items use 12px.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Footer copyright and fine print, muted.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Underline offset on text links; badge label gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in ghost buttons and badges; tag-to-title gap.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between feature tags and footer links; headline-to-subline.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Marquee vertical padding; tag horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Gap between hero actions and Bancada mosaic tiles.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter; badge horizontal padding; eyebrow-to-headline.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding; card inner padding on work cards.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Service-card and process-step vertical padding; nav link gap.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Stat item padding; space above hero actions.

tokens.name: space-60
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter and section-header bottom margin.

tokens.name: space-80
tokens.usage: Column gap in two-column sections; mobile section padding.

tokens.name: space-100
tokens.usage: Stats band vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-140
tokens.usage: Standard section vertical padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-160
tokens.usage: CTA section vertical padding.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Cards, grids and section blocks — the brand is square by default.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Small corners inside line icons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Floating hero badge and screenshot frames (Bancada images).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Lightbox content frame.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every button and feature tag.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Arrow circles, status dots, cursor.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: Primary button hover glow.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Image frame hover (lifted 6px).

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: Lightbox content.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Max width of every content section.

tokens.name: measure-hero
tokens.usage: Max width of the hero sub-paragraph.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Border width for all rules and outlines.

tokens.name: grid-pitch
tokens.usage: Background grid cell size behind the hero.
